name: auto_enter_verification_results
description: Automatically enter professional verification results into a web form or database using Anthropic Computer Use API. Claude will navigate to the URL, fill the form fields with verified data, submit, and capture screenshots. Perfect for automating CRM entry, database updates, or any web-based system. Requires Docker and Anthropic API key.

verification_data.description: Dictionary of verified data to enter (name, company, email, legitimacy_score, status, etc.)

target_url.description: URL of the form or system to fill (must be accessible from Docker container)

form_fields.description: Mapping of form field names to verification_data keys. Example: {'full_name': 'name', 'email_address': 'email'}

returns.records_created: int - Number of records created (1 if successful)
returns.actions_taken: List[str] - Log of all actions Claude performed
returns.ai_response: str - Claude's final response about the task

name: auto_enter_to_postgres
description: Directly insert verification results into a PostgreSQL database table without using Computer Use. Fast and efficient for bulk operations. Uses the platform's database connection. Specify table name, schema, and data dictionary. Data keys must match column names in the target table.

verification_data.description: Dictionary where keys are column names and values are data to insert

table_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL table to insert into

returns.records_created: int - Number of records created (1 if successful)
returns.insert_id: int - The ID of the inserted record (if table has RETURNING id)
returns.table: str - Full table name with schema

name: batch_enter_verifications
description: Process multiple verification results and automatically enter them into a system using Computer Use. Will iterate through each record, fill the form, submit, and verify. Good for bulk data entry after batch verification. Includes 2-second delays between entries to avoid rate limiting.

verification_list.description: List of verification data dictionaries to enter

target_url.description: URL of the form or system to fill

form_fields.description: Mapping of form field names to data keys

returns.success: bool - True if all records succeeded
returns.results: List[Dict] - Detailed results for each record
